Study Engine

One box. Type a problem and it solves it step by step. Paste notes or drop a file and it builds a summary, flashcards and a quiz. It works out the subject (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology) by itself, on your device, with no AI.

Paste, type or drop anything. It decides what to do and searches the web when it needs to.
On-device rewriting model (optional)

Type hf:yourname/simplifier to load the model from Hugging Face, or a folder name like models/ if you serve the page locally. Without a model the page still works using the built-in word swaps.
